This type of shard summons Spirit Guardians for [1] turns when the wearer takes damage, once per combat. The guardians deal[2] if the wearer worships a dark god, and[3] if they worship a light god or none.

Does not stack with identical shards.

The light gods are Selûne, Lathander, Tyr, Ilmater, Mystra, Moradin, Corellon Larethian, Garl Glittergold, Yondalla, Eilistraee, Tymora and Mielikki.

Radiant guardians also answer those who follow Tempus, Helm, Oghma or Kelemvor, and those who follow no god at all.
